title: Between Two Fires
author: Christopher Buehlman
summary: In plague-ravaged France in 1348, a knight meets a young girl who seems to have strange knowledge. They travel through a ruined countryside while angels and demons take an interest in her fate.
readIf: you like grim medieval horror with grit, black humour and a touch of the apocalyptic.
skipIf: you want comfort or hope, as the tone is bleak and the imagery is graphic.

pairings.reason: Another dark medieval story full of faith, fear and dangerous knowledge.
A very different look at life under an epidemic, more reflective and philosophical.
An atmospheric blend of history and horror that unfolds across old European landscapes.
